blocks.en: Each culture tube sits directly above an LED emitter, delivering light from below while keeping the culture closed and undisturbed throughout the run.
blocks.zh: 每一支培養試管都正好位於一顆 LED 發光體上方，光從下方照上來，整次運行中培養物都保持密閉、不受擾動。

blocks.en: Each culture tube is positioned above a single LED, while the housing separates the light paths between columns to limit light from neighboring LEDs.
blocks.zh: 每一支培養試管都對準單獨一顆 LED，外殼則把各欄之間的光路隔開，減少鄰近 LED 的光照進來。
六種條件，每種四支試管

blocks.en: Red and green light are tested across six conditions in parallel, with four replicate cultures assigned to each condition.
blocks.zh: 紅光與綠光在六種條件下同時測試，每一種條件配置四份重複培養。

blocks.en: PWM controls how long each LED is on during a cycle, creating the low, mid, and high intensity levels. Each intensity level is driven through its own MOSFET control channel across the array.
blocks.zh: PWM 控制每一顆 LED 在一個週期裡亮多久，藉此做出低、中、高三個強度。每一個強度在整座陣列上都由自己的 MOSFET 控制通道驅動。

blocks.en: The printed geometry fixes the position of the LEDs, tube rack, and housing, so the array can be reassembled with the same alignment each time.
blocks.zh: 列印件的幾何固定了 LED、試管支架與外殼的位置，所以陣列每次重新組裝都能回到相同的對位。

blocks.en: They clip into slots moulded into the plate, so the whole raft lifts clear of the reservoir without touching a plant.
blocks.zh: 它們卡入浮板上成型的插槽，整塊浮板因此能離開液槽，不碰到任何一株植物。

blocks.en: The raft floats on the nutrient solution and rides its surface.
blocks.zh: 浮板浮在培養液上，隨液面起伏。

blocks.en: Shoots rise from the baskets while the roots grow down through them into the water.
blocks.zh: 芽從種子座往上長，根則穿過種子座往下長進水裡。

blocks.en: The cone leaving the emitter is wider than the cuvette it has to cross. A focusing lens gathers it, and from here down the light is one tight column.
blocks.zh: 離開發光體的光錐，比它必須穿過的比色槽還寬。一枚聚焦透鏡把它收攏，從這裡往下，光就是一道緊密的光柱。
